title: Localized evaluation postcomposition
statement:
theorem tensorHomEvaluation_postcomposition (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (L M M' : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (c : DerivedCategory.Q.obj M ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj M') :
    letI := schemeDerivedTensorMonoidal X
    let E := fun L M : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ ↦
      ((schemeDerivedInternalHomResolutionIso X L M).hom ⊗ₘ
          𝟙 (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L)) ≫
        pullbackTensorModelMap X (homComplex (R := X.sheaf) L
          ((schemeHomKInjectiveResolution X).obj M)) L ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeTensorHomUncurry X _ L M (𝟙 _)) ≫
        schemeHomResolutionInverse X M
    ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf).map
        (𝟙 (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L)), c.inv) ⊗ₘ 𝟙 (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L)) ≫
        E L M = E L M' ≫ c.inv

proof.text: For a chain map f:M->N let h=HomComplex(id_L,I(f)). Apply schemeTensorHomUncurry_localized_evaluation twice: first to h as a change of the Hom input with target N fixed, then to identity Hom input with target map f. The two left sides agree, giving (Qh tensor id);mu;QU_N;v_N = mu;QU_M;v_M;Qf. Naturality of the fixed Localization.fac isomorphism j gives RHom(id, Qf);j_N = j_M;Qh. Tensor this equality with id_QL and reassociate to obtain E(L,M);Qf = (RHom(id,Qf) tensor id);E(L,N). This uses no K-flatness or homotopy lift.

Fix L and define the derived functor F(N)=RHom(QL,N) tensor QL by currying derivedInternalHom and composing with tensorRight(QL). The chain naturality proved above gives a natural transformation alpha:Q followed by F -> Q followed by identity whose component at M is E(L,M). Mathlib Localization.fullyFaithfulWhiskeringLeft gives a preimage beta:F->identity, and its map_preimage identity identifies beta at every Q(M) with exactly E(L,M). Apply beta.naturality to c.inv and substitute these component identities. This is the claimed equality, for all unbounded complexes and all isomorphisms c. Identity and zero complexes require no special cases.
